name: Plus Languages
author: TIde
description: Language support for the TI-83 Plus and 84 Plus: z80 assembly (.z80, with ti83plus.inc's bcalls and addresses), and TI-BASIC patterns for the Plus's 16×8 home screen and 95×63 graph screen.

snippets.description: A TI-83 Plus / 84 Plus assembly program (spasm): clears the screen and prints a message
Read keys with _GetCSC until Clear is pressed
Clear the graph buffer, draw, and show it
A blank TI-83 Plus / 84 Plus graph screen, one unit per pixel
A title screen for the Plus's 16×8 home screen

completions.label: _ClrLCDFull
completions.documentation: Clears the whole LCD (not the home screen buffer).

completions.label: _ClrScrnFull
completions.documentation: Clears the home screen, its text buffer and the split screen.

completions.label: _HomeUp
completions.documentation: Moves the text cursor to the top left: curRow and curCol to 0.

completions.label: _PutS
completions.documentation: Prints the zero-terminated string at hl at curRow, curCol, in the large font.

completions.label: _PutC
completions.documentation: Prints the character in a at curRow, curCol, and moves the cursor.

completions.label: _PutMap
completions.documentation: Prints the character in a at curRow, curCol without moving the cursor.

completions.label: _DispHL
completions.documentation: Prints hl as an unsigned number, right-aligned in 5 characters.

completions.label: _NewLine
completions.documentation: Moves the cursor to the start of the next line, scrolling if needed.

completions.label: _VPutS
completions.documentation: Prints the zero-terminated string at hl in the small font at penRow, penCol.

completions.label: _VPutMap
completions.documentation: Prints the character in a in the small font at penRow, penCol.

completions.label: _GetKey
completions.documentation: Waits for a key and returns its key code in a. Handles 2nd, alpha, contrast and turning off.

completions.label: _GetCSC
completions.documentation: Scans the keypad: a is the scan code of a newly pressed key, or 0 (sk… names).

completions.label: _GrBufCpy
completions.documentation: Copies the graph buffer (plotSScreen) to the LCD.

completions.label: _GrBufClr
completions.documentation: Clears the graph buffer (plotSScreen).

completions.label: _ILine
completions.documentation: Draws a line from (b, c) to (d, e) in the graph buffer; h is 1 to draw, 0 to erase, 2 to invert.

completions.label: _IPoint
completions.documentation: Draws a pixel at (b, c) in the graph buffer; d is 1 to draw, 0 to erase, 2 to invert, 3 to test.

completions.label: _RunIndicOff
completions.documentation: Turns off the run indicator in the top right corner.

completions.label: _RunIndicOn
completions.documentation: Turns the run indicator back on.

completions.label: _DelVarArc
completions.documentation: Deletes the variable whose VAT entry is at hl and data at de, archived or not.

completions.label: _ChkFindSym
completions.documentation: Finds the variable named in OP1: hl is its VAT entry, de its data, b its flash page (0 in RAM). Carry if it isn't there.

completions.label: _Mov9ToOP1
completions.documentation: Copies 9 bytes from hl to OP1, such as a variable name.

completions.label: _CreateProg
completions.documentation: Creates a program named in OP1 with hl bytes; de is its data.

completions.label: _EnableApd
completions.documentation: Turns automatic power down back on.

completions.label: _DisableApd
completions.documentation: Turns automatic power down off.

completions.label: userMem
completions.documentation: Where the running program is loaded.

completions.label: plotSScreen
completions.documentation: The graph buffer: 768 bytes, 12 per row, 64 rows. _GrBufCpy shows it.

completions.label: saveSScreen
completions.documentation: 768 bytes of free RAM, used by the OS when it turns off.

completions.label: appBackUpScreen
completions.documentation: 768 bytes of free RAM.

completions.label: curRow
completions.documentation: The text cursor's row, 0 to 7.

completions.label: curCol
completions.documentation: The text cursor's column, 0 to 15.

completions.label: penCol
completions.documentation: The small font's x position, 0 to 95.

completions.label: penRow
completions.documentation: The small font's y position, 0 to 63.

completions.label: OP1
completions.documentation: The first of the OS's 11-byte floating-point and name registers.

completions.label: skDown
completions.documentation: Scan code of the down arrow, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: skLeft
completions.documentation: Scan code of the left arrow, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: skRight
completions.documentation: Scan code of the right arrow, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: skUp
completions.documentation: Scan code of the up arrow, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: skEnter
completions.documentation: Scan code of Enter, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: skClear
completions.documentation: Scan code of Clear, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: sk2nd
completions.documentation: Scan code of 2nd, from _GetCSC.

completions.label: bcall
completions.documentation: Calls an OS routine (rst 28h, then its address).
